name: Samhain Wear
lines: A great carved pumpkin worn as a head, lit softly from inside.
Shroud of the Otherworld
A long pale cloak that fades to mist at the hem.
Crown of Samhain Candles
A black iron crown of seven steady candles, lit from the Tlachtga fire.
Black raven feathers bound in silver, as the Morrigan might wear.
Veil of the Thin Place
A drift of grey-silver gauze over the face, pale at the hem.
A twisted bronze torc set with an ember that never goes out.
Antlers of the Wild Hunt
Dark antlers twined with ivy and red berries.
Bone-White Half Mask
A pale carved half mask with silver at the brow.
A black cape cut in scalloped bat wings, lined in pumpkin orange.
Straw Guiser's Mask
The old guising mask of plaited straw, so the wandering dead won't know you.
Golden Snap-Apple Brooch
A little gold apple on an orange ribbon, from the barrel itself.
Black lace gloves spun like a spider's web.
Scarecrow's straw hat
